items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It wasn't Cliff Keene, was it? [INTERVIEWEE] No. It was another guy.

ctx.x: Yeah, Jay-Joe(?) and the other one, the one who plays clarinet upside-down.
I can't think of his name. It wasn't Cliff Keene, was it?
No. It was another guy. Later Paul showed me him in New York. He was a master clarinet player from one of them islands.
